description: Two defects that only the dev environment shows; CI and mix ci run in the test environment, so they pass. Reproduce with MIX_ENV=dev mix compile on main (76fd9d8). 1. error: Defk.LanguageDoc.Example.__struct__/1 is undefined, cannot expand struct Defk.LanguageDoc.Example, at dev/mix/tasks/defk.stability.freeze.ex (the task builds %Example{} and calls Defk.LanguageDoc, which lives in test/support/language_doc.ex; elixirc_paths(:dev) compiles lib, dev and only test/support/examples.ex and catalog.ex). mix.exs names the task's preferred env as :test, but the dev compile still compiles dev/. Fixes to weigh: add test/support/language_doc.ex (and language_doc/isolated.ex if needed) to the dev paths; or move Defk.LanguageDoc under dev/; or keep the task out of the dev compile. 2. warning: module attribute @kinds was set but never used, lib/defk/deprecations.ex: the only use is inside the for over @entries, which is empty outside the test environment (config/config.exs sets the test entries), so the loop body never compiles and the attribute goes unused. Use @kinds in a function head or guard, or validate entries in a function called once, so the attribute is used whatever the table holds. Done when MIX_ENV=dev mix compile --warnings-as-errors passes on a clean build, and mix ci still passes.

comments.text: PR #17 (branch defk-0gk-rzr/dev-compile-and-remarks-cache): dev paths add test/support/language_doc*, @kinds read before the loop. mix ci green; MIX_ENV=dev mix compile --warnings-as-errors passes.

title: mix compile in the dev environment fails on the stability freeze task and warns in Defk.Deprecations
